incident: May 2026 Mini Shai-Hulud npm supply-chain compromise

scope.scannerPackageSet: TanStack @tanstack/* package/version indicators plus selected confirmed broader Mini Shai-Hulud npm, PyPI, Composer, and RubyGems indicators
scope.officialTanStackScope: 42 packages, 84 malicious versions, published on 2026-05-11 between 19:20 and 19:26 UTC
scope.campaignContext: Socket reports 416 affected package artifacts for the Mini Shai-Hulud campaign as of 2026-05-12, spanning npm, PyPI, and one Composer artifact. JFrog reports more than 170 npm packages and 2 PyPI packages affected by Shai-Hulud: Here We Go Again, with the PyPI second-stage payload updated into a credential stealer as of May 13. Socket reports 155 package artifacts for the GemStuffer RubyGems registry-abuse campaign as of 2026-05-13. Exact scanner detections are stored in this file; namespace warnings and filename-only Ruby indicators remain lower-confidence review prompts.
